evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫 (Chinese University of Hong Kong)
evidence.field: 謝: 說文; 形義通解; component analysis
evidence.text: The entry reports the Shuowen analysis “辤去也。从言，射聲” and identifies 言 as semantic and 射 as phonetic in 謝. It calls resignation the original sense, then lists transmitted-text examples for declining, taking leave, fading or disappearing, removal, apology, thanks, and succession. These examples do not date the first attestation of each sense.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫: 謝

evidence.text: The entry explicitly defines 訁 as the written form of the Kangxi radical 言 used on the left side of a character. This supports classifying 言 → 訁 as a positional full-form relationship, not as the simplified-form pair 訁 → 讠.
evidence.title: 訁,言字邊 - Cantonese Dictionary

evidence.text: The supplied local Unihan_Readings.txt rows give kMandarin 言 yán, 訁 yán, 射 shè, 謝 xiè, and 谢 xiè. These are current-reading metadata only and do not establish an ancient sound relationship. Attempts to inspect the official character-specific Unihan records were inaccessible in this web pass; the local readings therefore remain local-only evidence rather than externally verified record findings.

evidence.kind: local dataset cross-check; official page unavailable

evidence.text: Supplied local rows: 謝 MC zjaeH, OC *sə-lAk-s (“decline, renounce”); 射 has MC zyaeH, OC *Cə.lAk-s (“shoot; archer”) and MC zyek, OC *Cə.lAk (“hit with bow and arrow”); 言 has MC ngjon, OC *ŋa[n] (“a particle”; “I, we”; “speak; speech”) and OC *ŋa[r] (“tall”). The rows belong to Baxter–Sagart 2014 and must not be merged with Zhengzhang reconstructions. No upstream table page was verified in this research pass, so these are local-only checks, not external citations.

evidence.field: kSimplifiedVariant/kTraditionalVariant property definition; character-specific opens attempted
evidence.text: The supplied dossier records 謝 U+8B1D with kSimplifiedVariant 谢 U+8C22 and 谢 with reciprocal kTraditionalVariant 謝. Unicode UAX #38 describes these properties as simplified and traditional variant mappings. Character-specific Unihan pages were inaccessible during this pass, so the local pair was not independently re-inspected upstream. This pair supports simplified_form only for the complete graph pair 謝 → 谢; it does not change the classification of 訁 with origin_form 言.
evidence.kind: official property definition plus local record provenance
evidence.title: UAX #38: Unicode Han Database (Unihan)

search_audit.query: Unicode UAX #38 Unihan kMandarin kSimplifiedVariant definitions
search_audit.outcome: Opened and inspected the official property documentation. It defines kMandarin as customary pinyin metadata and documents kSimplifiedVariant and kTraditionalVariant as simplified/traditional variant properties.

gaps: For the component record with form 訁 and origin_form 言, classify the relation as full_form: an inspected dictionary explicitly identifies 訁 as the left-position written form of radical 言. The reviewer’s requested simplified_form classification would apply to the distinct pair 訁 → 讠, not the literal component pair 訁/言.

Unihan local rows were supplied and checked for both component and host characters, but current official character-specific pages could not be opened or verified. Do not claim those upstream pages were inspected; retain the provided local readings as local-source metadata only.

The local Baxter–Sagart rows show comparable listed OC forms for 謝 and 射, alongside a distinct 言 reading. They support a comparison within that dataset but do not replace or merge with the dossier’s Zhengzhang forms, and do not establish the original name/pronunciation of the depicted bow-and-arrow object in 射.

No new inscriptional evidence or dated first-use attestations were established. The original graph chronology and dates and semantic links among resignation, refusal, leave-taking, fading, removal, apology, thanks, and succession remain unresolved.
